meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动控制浏览器，执行打开网页、填写表单、点击按钮、截图、提取数据等操作。
howto.when: 当你需要让 Claude 帮你操作网页，比如填写表单、截图或提取信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开 example.com 并截图
say.note: Claude 会打开网页并保存截图。

say.text: 在搜索框输入“天气”并点击搜索按钮
say.note: Claude 会定位元素并执行操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate browser interactions: navigate to URLs, fill forms, click elements, take screenshots, extract data, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need Claude to interact with web pages, such as filling forms, taking screenshots, or extracting information.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will open the page and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Type 'weather' in the search box and click the search button.
say_en.note: Claude will locate elements and perform actions.
